id: title:jurajmajerik:log experiments settings changes to the activity log

review.posthog_relevance: Adds configuration and activity description support for Team Experiments, including new fields and handlers for experiment settings.
review.reason: Adds a handler and several new fields to the TEAM_PROPERTIES_MAPPING for experiment configuration, including default statistical method, confidence level, minimum detectable effect, and CUPED settings. P1.F1.H1 imports the configuration, P1.F1.H2 adds a handler for clearing configuration, and P1.F1.H3 adds several new fields. This is a substantive, bounded capability improvement.
review.uncertainty: Chunk does not include complete implementation of TeamExperimentsConfig model or TeamActivityDescriber component, making it impossible to verify full behavior of new fields and handlers.

observations.limitations: This chunk does not include the complete implementation of the TeamExperimentsConfig model or the complete TeamActivityDescriber component, making it impossible to verify the full behavior of the new fields and handlers. observations.behavior: Adds import for ExperimentsConfig, which is used to track experiment configuration settings.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows the team activity describer to access experiment configuration settings, which are used to generate activity descriptions.

observations.behavior: Adds a new handler function for experiment configuration changes, which is used to generate activity descriptions for experiment configuration changes.
